nodes.text:
BREAKING: China is witnessing a surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, sparking concerns of another health crisis after COVID-19 pandemic, per NDTV news.

HMPV causes flu-like symptoms and lead to severe respiratory issues, especially among children and vulnerable groups.
